# Zeyad Omran

> Personal portfolio of Zeyad Omran, a software developer at IBM focused on AI assistant interfaces, reusable UI builders, frontend performance, and human computer interaction.

The portfolio presents selected frontend contributions, experience, education, design writing, and contact information. Its theme is "Complexity, made human."

The interactive figures use illustrative content. The assistant is a layout study with a scripted conversation and local form state. The component builder demonstrates local configuration. The eight-to-three-second rendering comparison illustrates a reported field-template/parser optimization, separate from the shared-table replacement; it is not a live benchmark.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://zeyadomran.com/): Introduction and an interactive illustration of People, Interface, and System.
- [AI assistant interfaces](https://zeyadomran.com/#assistant): Frontend delivery of an assistant from proof of concept to production, with workspaces that keep tasks beside the conversation.
- [Reusable interfaces and UI builders](https://zeyadomran.com/#systems): Shared frontend widgets, UI builder expansion, coordinated data, and configurable layouts.
- [Rendering performance](https://zeyadomran.com/#optimization): Parallel execution and early exit guards in a table parsing path, with a reported reduction from eight seconds to three.
- [About and experience](https://zeyadomran.com/#about): Background in human computer interaction, IBM experience, education, and tools.
- [Writing](https://zeyadomran.com/#writing): Introduction to Behind the Interface, a design blog about typography, layout, motion, and interaction.
- [Contact](https://zeyadomran.com/#links): Email, resume download, and professional profiles.
- [Resume](https://zeyadomran.com/Zeyad_Omran_Resume_SWE_AI.pdf): Downloadable resume in PDF format.
